Hi Priya,

Thanks for the SIG bundle you returned earlier — the team reviewed the answers and had a few follow-ups specifically around data lifecycle and whether customer prompts/logs are used for model training. Can you please confirm the following explicitly for HealthSuite:

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, Apr 13, 2027 at 11:06 AM PDT

Priya / Soojin — draft answers and artifact list below. I left the language intentionally concise so we can paste directly into the SIG document.

1) On training with customer data:
- "Redwood Inference does not use customer prompts, conversation logs, or request payloads to train or update any production models by default. Model training using customer data occurs only if a customer signs an explicit training opt-in agreement that specifies datasets, retention, and redaction requirements. Opt-ins are tracked in our contract system and enforced in the ingestion pipeline by an opt-in flag."

Operational control: ingestion pipeline checks customer profile flag (training_opt_in = true) and routes flagged data to isolated training buckets; otherwise data is excluded from training pipelines.

2) Retention windows and snapshots:
- Debug-level traces (detailed request/response pairs including system logs): default TTL = 7 days.
- Structured request metadata (tokens, request ids, timestamps, routing metadata): default TTL = 30 days.
- Audit snapshots: we periodically (quarterly or on-request) produce a redacted snapshot for compliance reviews that is archived for 365 days in a restricted snapshot archive. Snapshots are created under an internal policy (RetentionPolicyID: RP-2026-09) and access-controlled.

Note: the "snapshot" is a compressed, redacted package (policy-applied) — we never store unredacted customer prompts in long-term archives unless the customer has explicitly opted into archival for training/analytics.

3) Evidence artifacts I can attach: 
- retention_policy_snapshot_2027-04-12.zip (redacted manifest + TTLs)
- soc2_type2_excerpt.pdf (relevant controls section: logging and change management)
- training_optout_manifest.csv (list of contract IDs currently marked opt-out)
- redwood_sig_data_answers_v1.pdf (formatted SIG answers)

S3/Archive manifest (redacted example): redacted://snapshots/rp-2026-09/2027-04-12/manifest.json (we will redact the account/bucket names in the public bundle).

If you want me to tighten the language for legal, I can do a second pass. Also adding the pointer to our internal attestation page: https://redwood-internal.company/attestations/soc2/2026-type2

Rishi
Principal, Applied Systems

Hi Elena — thanks for the patience. Attaching a short evidence pack that addresses each of your bullets. Highlights below and attachments referenced.

- Training on customer data: Redwood does NOT use customer prompts/conversations to train production models by default. Any training that uses customer data requires an explicit opt-in (contract flag + ingestion-level enforcement). See attached: redwood_sig_data_answers_v1.pdf and training_optout_manifest.csv.

- Retention windows: debug-level traces = 7 days; structured request metadata = 30 days; redacted audit snapshots produced on-request or quarterly and retained for 365 days under policy RP-2026-09. See attachment: retention_policy_snapshot_2027-04-12.zip (manifest redacted) and soc2_type2_excerpt.pdf.

- Opt-out enforcement: customers who select "training opt-out" are marked in our contract system (manifest attached) and the ingestion pipeline filters those records from all training queues. The control is enforced at the point of data routing and validated by nightly compliance jobs (summary included in the zip).

Attachments included in this bundle (redacted for external distribution): redwood_sig_data_answers_v1.pdf, retention_policy_snapshot_2027-04-12.zip, training_optout_manifest.csv, soc2_type2_excerpt.pdf

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Rishi and Soojin next week to go through the manifest and controls. Which day/time works for your team?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Compliance & GTM Security
Redwood Inference
